opening.argument: The presentation requires a payment to enter: the speaker says, "we need 13 dollars for level 1 joining," and links obtaining that amount to the joining process. It then describes a structure in which payments are directed through the plan, including that "the payment of X3 goes to the planner," while commissions are tied to downstream participants. The earnings pitch extends beyond personal work, stating, "You will earn even if you do not work and team work," and connects claimed results to making 27 members whose activity continues ahead. The presentation therefore frames Forsage BUSD X3/X4 as a paid recruitment and tiered-commission opportunity. Although the speaker notes that some participants earned nothing for three months, and the displayed payments and balances are not verified, the account still includes claims of earnings without work and an earnings account associated with adding 27 members.
